kultivator.goals.reward.6: A Blood-and-Fire Trial Token and 4 Low spirit stones
kultivator.goals.reward.7: 2 Mid spirit stones and a Heavenvoid Map Fragment
kultivator.goals.reward.8: 1 High spirit stone and a vial of Ancient God Blood
kultivator.goals.reward.9: 1 Supreme spirit stone and a Heavenly Tomb Sigil
kultivator.goals.reward.10: 3 Tomb Energy Essences and the title "Master of the World Path"
kultivator.goals.step.w_ring: Bind a storage pouch or ring
kultivator.goals.step.w_ring.how: Use a storage ring once to plant your spiritual imprint (the first ring needs Qi Refining).
kultivator.goals.step.w_forge.how: Build an Earthfire Forge over a heat source and finish a Tempa Baru job.
kultivator.goals.step.w_gate.how: Use a realm key on open ground (a Blood-and-Fire token for Qi Refining and Foundation).
kultivator.goals.step.w_pledge.how: Place a Sect Patron Plaque near a village bell and defend it through the Night Watch.
kultivator.goals.step.w_ambush.how: Travel far from any hall; when rogue cultivators bar the road, defeat a band of three or more.
kultivator.goals.step.w_raid.how: From hall level 3, demonic sects raid your hall. Stay in your territory on raid night and hold the seal.
kultivator.goals.step.w_natal.how: At Golden Core, take a Misterius artifact into your body (Pusaka tablet: Ikat).
kultivator.goals.step.w_heavenvoid.how: Join three Heavenvoid Map Fragments into a map and clear the second secret realm.
kultivator.goals.step.w_langit.how: Forge over Earth Lung Fire with Soul Nurturing Wood from the Heavenvoid Hall.
kultivator.goals.step.w_spirit.how: Raise your natal treasure's spirit to Roh Dasar (400 years, or a Beast Soul at the forge).
kultivator.goals.step.w_crystal.how: Enter the Land of the Ancient God with an Inheritance Ice Crystal and absorb one crystal.
kultivator.goals.step.w_patriarch.how: Slay the Patriarch who leads the final wave of a great sect raid.
kultivator.goals.step.w_refine.how: Re-temper an artifact at the forge with High stones and Ancient God Blood.
kultivator.goals.step.w_tomb9: Reach layer 9 of the Heavenly Tomb
kultivator.goals.step.w_tomb9.how: Descend into the Heavenly Tomb with a Tomb Sigil and defeat the guardian of layer 9.
kultivator.goals.step.w_vassals.how: Raise your hall to level 6 and win the oaths of three villages.
kultivator.goals.step.w_ring4.how: Upgrade a High storage ring at a forge with Langit heat.
kultivator.goals.step.w_spirit3.how: A natural spirit of 1,000 years in an Abadi treasure, tempered by a tribulation you pass while it is bound.
kultivator.goals.step.w_dewa.how: Forge with Heavenly Flame and Tomb Energy Essence.
kultivator.goals.step.w_tomb81: Reach layer 81 of the Heavenly Tomb
kultivator.goals.step.w_tomb81.how: Keep descending: every ninth layer has a guardian.
kultivator.goals.step.w_loyal.how: Answer requests, repel raids, post a guardian and bring gifts until a village's loyalty is full.

advancement.kultivator.world_path_comple: Finish all twenty steps of the World Path (chapters 6-10)
kultivator.screen.help.jalan_dunia.title: The World Path
kultivator.screen.help.jalan_dunia: After the five chapters of First Steps, the Path tablet turns to the World Path (the coin under the chapter tablets): chapters 6-10, twenty steps that tie the phase-8 features together, each ticked by its achievement and each chapter with one reward (a realm key, spirit stones, Ancient God Blood, a Tomb Sigil, Tomb Energy Essence and the title "Master of the World Path"). Each realm feeds the next: the Blood-and-Fire trial gives Foundation Herbs for Bumi forging and an alternative Foundation pill; the Heavenvoid Hall gives Soul Nurturing Wood for Langit forging, weapon spirits and the Supreme ring; the Land of the Ancient God gives Ancient God Blood for Abadi forging and +7 to +9 refining; the Heavenly Tomb gives Tomb Energy Essence for Dewa forging and +10 to +12. Each Essence you carry when condensing a star lowers its cost by 2%% (at most 10, they are used up). Foundation Trials gain an optional fourth row from the world features; any three rows make a Firm Foundation. New daily chores: slay rogue cultivators, finish a village request, forge or refine, clear a secret realm. Source: the ladder and every number are game design; each feature names its own source.
